name: AULA F75
author: crucialjun
description: Lighting, colour, sleep, debounce and lock-key (Caps/Num/Scroll) control for the AULA F75 keyboard over USB or the 2.4 GHz dongle, with optional theme-accent sync

barWidget.description: Keyboard lighting and lock-key popup for the AULA F75

schema.label: Theme sync
schema.description: Re-colour the keyboard whenever the Omarchy theme accent changes.

schema.label: Hide when disconnected
